description: SE · Education · gtg.se zoominfo.com/c/göteborgsregionens-tekniska-gymnasium/458572877 GTG technical upper-secondary school (gymnasium) owned by 13 Gothenburg-area municipalities (via the Göteborgsregionens kommunalförbund) — founded in 2006 specifically to solve the region's engineering talent shortage, the first inter-municipal school of its kind in Sweden.
